collection.title: Audi Cabriolet 1997 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 1997 to 2000 version of the Audi Cabriolet which requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Side Latch type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
